FROM wms_stock_flow f JOIN wms_warehouse wh ON wh.id = f.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN wms_stock_doc d ON f.biz_type IN ('IN', 'OUT', 'TRANSFER') AND d.id = f.doc_id LEFT JOIN wms_check c ON f.biz_type = 'CHECK' AND c.id = f.doc_id WHERE wh.type <> 'CONSIGN_IN' AND COALESCE(d.biz_date, c.biz_date, CAST(f.create_time AS DATE)) <= #{asOf}
AND f.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND f.biz_type <> 'TRANSFER'
mapper.select:
SELECT m.id AS "materialId", m.code AS "code", m.name AS "name", m.spec AS "spec", m.unit AS "unit", m.category AS "category", t.qty AS "qty" FROM ( SELECT f.material_id, SUM(f.qty) AS qty
GROUP BY f.material_id ) t JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = t.material_id WHERE t.qty > 0 AND m.category = #{category} AND (m.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY m.code

SELECT f.material_id AS "materialId", COALESCE(d.biz_date, c.biz_date, CAST(f.create_time AS DATE)) AS "bizDate", SUM(f.qty) AS "qty"
AND f.qty > 0 AND f.material_id IN #{id} GROUP BY f.material_id, COALESCE(d.biz_date, c.biz_date, CAST(f.create_time AS DATE)) ORDER BY f.material_id, COALESCE(d.biz_date, c.biz_date, CAST(f.create_time AS DATE)) DESC
